WITNESSETH: WHEREAS Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 28 in Block 692 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 509 West 20" Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit"A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferor Lot"); WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property, with the buildings and improvements located thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 42 in Block 690 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 516-522 West 19" Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferee Lot"); WHEREAS, the Transferor Lot is a "granting site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the "Zoning Resolution") and the Transferee Lot is a "receiving site", as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the “floor area", as defined in § 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Transferor Lot includes 36,800 square feet of floor area that is unused and availablefor transfer under$98-30of theZoningResolution.
